gk.name: Goalkeeper
gk.gives: Reliable shot stopping on his line
gk.costs: Leaves space in behind the defensive line

sweeper_keeper.name: Sweeper keeper
sweeper_keeper.description: Comes off his line to sweep behind the defence.
sweeper_keeper.gives: Sweeps through balls and cuts out one-on-ones early
sweeper_keeper.costs: Vulnerable to long-range chips; risk of fouls outside the box

cb.name: Centre-back
cb.costs: Less proactive in stepping out to challenge

stopper.name: Stopper
stopper.description: Steps out to win it early.
stopper.gives: Wins tackles and headers early in front of the line
stopper.costs: Leaves space behind if beaten; commits more fouls

covering_cb.name: Covering centre-back
covering_cb.description: Drops off and sweeps up behind.
covering_cb.gives: Cuts out opponent through balls behind the line

ball_playing_cb.name: Ball-playing centre-back
ball_playing_cb.description: Brings it out and starts attacks.
ball_playing_cb.gives: Progressive passes and accurate long switches from deep
ball_playing_cb.costs: Vulnerable to high pressing turnovers in defensive third

fb.name: Full-back
fb.gives: Balanced flank play in attack and defence
fb.costs: Neither locks down the wing nor overloads attack

fb_defensive.name: Defensive full-back
fb_defensive.description: Stays home and guards the flank.
fb_defensive.gives: Flank lockdown; stifles opponent wide attacks
fb_defensive.costs: Offers little width or attacking support

fb_overlapping.name: Overlapping full-back
fb_overlapping.description: Bursts past the winger to cross.
fb_overlapping.gives: Dangerous crosses from the byline and attacking overloads
fb_overlapping.costs: Leaves space behind on opponent counters; higher fatigue

fb_inverted.name: Inverted full-back
fb_inverted.description: Steps into midfield when we have it.
fb_inverted.gives: Central midfield overload and progressive passing options
fb_inverted.costs: Leaves flank exposed to direct counter-attacks; fewer crosses

dm.name: Holding midfielder
dm.gives: Positional protection in front of the centre-backs
dm.costs: Limited forward passing and through balls

anchor.name: Anchor
anchor.description: Never leaves the space in front of the defence.
anchor.costs: Rarely steps forward or contributes to progressive play

deep_playmaker.name: Deep playmaker
deep_playmaker.gives: Demands the ball deep and hits pinpoint long switches
deep_playmaker.costs: Turnovers can spark immediate opponent counters under high press

ball_winner.name: Ball-winner
ball_winner.gives: Relentless pressing and aggressive tackles to regain possession
ball_winner.costs: Commits more fouls and cards; drains stamina rapidly

box_to_box.name: Box-to-box
box_to_box.gives: High work-rate presence in both penalty boxes

playmaker.name: Playmaker
playmaker.description: Gets on the ball and picks the pass.
playmaker.gives: Unlocks defences with incisive through balls and vision
playmaker.costs: Offers less physical and pressing resistance defensively

runner.name: Late runner
runner.gives: Surprise goal threat with late runs into the penalty area
runner.costs: Vacates midfield space for opponent counters

am.name: Number 10
am.gives: Creative link between midfield and attack

shadow_striker.name: Shadow striker
shadow_striker.description: Plays off the striker and gets in the box.
shadow_striker.gives: Second striker presence with clinical shots in the box
shadow_striker.costs: Minimal tracking back or pressing support in midfield

wm.name: Wide midfielder
wm.gives: Solid work-rate up and down the touchline

wm_defensive.name: Defensive winger
wm_defensive.description: Tracks back to help his full-back.
wm_defensive.gives: Double cover on the flank against opposing wingers
wm_defensive.costs: Reduced attacking output and fewer take-ons

wide_playmaker.name: Wide playmaker
wide_playmaker.description: Drifts inside to make things happen.
wide_playmaker.gives: Creative through balls and switches by floating inside
wide_playmaker.costs: Surrenders natural width on the flank

wf.name: Wide forward
wf.gives: Direct attacking threat in the final third

winger.name: Winger
winger.description: Hugs the line, beats his man, crosses.
winger.gives: Dangerous crosses and 1v1 take-ons on the byline
winger.costs: Rarely cuts inside to shoot at goal

inside_forward.name: Inside forward
inside_forward.gives: Direct goal threat driving inside onto his stronger foot
inside_forward.costs: Fewer crosses; requires overlapping full-back to maintain width

st.name: Striker
st.costs: Lacks specialist aerial dominance or deep playmaking

target_man.name: Target man
target_man.description: Wins headers and holds it up.
target_man.gives: Dominates aerial duels, holds up play, knocks balls down
target_man.costs: Limited mobility on through balls; rarely dribbles

poacher.name: Poacher
poacher.gives: Deadly finishing instincts in and around the six-yard box
poacher.costs: Rarely touches the ball outside the penalty area; no pressing

pressing_forward.name: Pressing forward
pressing_forward.description: Leads the press from the front.
pressing_forward.gives: Forces defensive errors and wins the ball high up the pitch
pressing_forward.costs: Higher fatigue drain; slightly reduced goal output

false_nine.name: False nine
false_nine.description: Drops deep and drags defenders out.
false_nine.gives: Drags centre-backs out of position and slips through balls
false_nine.costs: Fewer bodies in the box to convert crosses

advanced_forward.name: Advanced forward
advanced_forward.gives: Stretches defences on the shoulder and creates one-on-ones
advanced_forward.costs: Catches offside more frequently; contributes less to buildup

tightMark.name: Tight mark
tightMark.wording: Stay touch-tight on {player}. He'll see less of the ball, but his marker gets dragged about.
tightMark.gives: Drastically reduces target's touches; tight challenges
tightMark.costs: Leaves space behind marker; increases marker fouls

doubleUp.name: Double up
doubleUp.wording: Two on {player} whenever he has it. It leaves space on the other side.
doubleUp.gives: Smothers the target whenever he receives the ball
doubleUp.costs: Leaves open space in the opposite flank

pressOnBall.name: Press on ball
pressOnBall.wording: Close {player} down the moment he gets it. If he beats the press, we're open.
pressOnBall.gives: Presses target relentlessly in his half; forces errors
pressOnBall.costs: If he beats the press, your defence is wide open

showInside.name: Show inside
showInside.wording: Force {player} inside. Fewer crosses, more shots.
showInside.gives: Prevents crosses and forces wide players into crowded central areas

showOutside.name: Show outside
showOutside.wording: Force {player} down the line. Fewer shots, more crosses.
showOutside.gives: Forces attackers wide away from the goalmouth
showOutside.costs: Concedes more crosses into your penalty area

CounterPress.name: Counter-press
CounterPress.wording: Win it back in seconds. Get it wrong and they're through.
CounterPress.gives: Immediate regains in opponent's half after turnovers
CounterPress.costs: Opponent breaks clear on a counter if press is bypassed; stamina drain

Regroup.name: Regroup
Regroup.wording: Get back into shape and let them have it.
Regroup.gives: Protects against counter-attacks by dropping into defensive shape
Regroup.costs: No early ball regains in opponent half; allows them clean buildup

Mixed.name: Mixed
Mixed.gives: Balanced tactical decisions depending on match situation

Counter.name: Counter
Counter.gives: Fast counter-attacking breaks immediately after winning the ball
Counter.costs: Rushed final passes when opponent defence is settled

KeepIt.name: Keep it
KeepIt.wording: Calm down and keep the ball.
KeepIt.gives: Calm retention and safe circulation after regaining possession

Short.name: Short
Short.gives: Safe ball retention starting from the centre-backs
Short.costs: High risk of defensive third turnovers against high pressing

Long.name: Long
Long.wording: Go long to the front men.
Long.gives: Direct balls to attacking aerial targets, bypassing opposition press
Long.costs: 45% of deliveries are contested duels rather than clean retention

Wide.name: Wide
Wide.gives: Early progressive passes out to the flanks
Wide.costs: Limits central passing angles on the first step

Mixed.name: Mixed
Mixed.gives: Keeper judges the best option for each situation

NearPost.name: Near post
NearPost.gives: Flick-ons at the front stick; limits keeper claims

FarPost.name: Far post
FarPost.wording: Big men at the back stick.
FarPost.gives: Overloads the back stick with your strongest aerial threats
FarPost.costs: Goalkeeper has longer to claim the cross

Short.name: Short
Short.wording: Work it short and keep the ball.
Short.gives: Retains possession and creates better crossing angles
Short.costs: No immediate header on goal from the delivery

Mixed.name: Mixed
Mixed.gives: Taker picks target based on defensive setup

Zonal.name: Zonal
Zonal.gives: Protects key danger areas near the front post
Zonal.costs: Vulnerable to aerial mismatches at the back post

ManMark.name: Man-mark
ManMark.wording: Pick up a man each. Watch the wrestling.
ManMark.gives: Matches best header directly to the opponent's main threat
ManMark.costs: 4% risk of conceding a penalty for holding/shirt-pulling

shootMore.wording: Shoot more: try his luck from distance.
shootMore.costs: More low-xG shots; turnovers on blocked attempts

shootLess.wording: Shoot less: work a better chance.
shootLess.gives: More patient buildup in the final third
shootLess.costs: Fewer shots overall; risks being tackled while looking for a pass

dribbleMore.costs: Failed dribbles surrender possession higher up the pitch

dribbleLess.costs: Fewer solo chances created or fouls won

crossMore.wording: Get it in the box early.
crossMore.gives: More frequent early deliveries into the penalty box

crossLess.gives: Maintains ground passing in wide areas

getForward.gives: Additional attacking support in the opponent's third
getForward.costs: Vacates defensive zone on opponent counters; stamina drain

holdPosition.costs: Offers less dynamic support when attacking

stayWider.gives: Stretches opposition defence across the pitch
stayWider.costs: Fewer central bodies to control midfield recycling

closeDownMore.costs: Higher stamina drain; opponent breaks free if pressing is beaten

stayOnFeet.gives: Fewer fouls, cards, and penalties conceded

longThrows.gives: Throw-ins in attacking third become dangerous box deliveries
longThrows.costs: Takes longer to set up; keeper claim chance slightly higher
